units.source_text: 自桐壶院以至诸亲王及公卿，无不致送礼物，所馈赠的都是珍贵物品。

en.t: From the Retired Emperor Kiritsubo down to the various princes and court nobles, everyone sent gifts, and all the offerings were precious things.

units.source_text: 庆贺之夜，看到这些礼物，家人无不欢天喜地，热闹非常。

en.t: On the night of the celebration, when the family saw these gifts, everyone was overjoyed, and the house was extraordinarily lively.

units.source_text: 又因诞生的是男儿，所以各项礼仪格外隆重。

en.t: And because the child who had been born was a boy, every ceremony was conducted with exceptional solemnity.
